newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Firmer cash markets but futures gains may be getting overdone.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Index up but higher corn futures calls will weigh on market.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.200 to off 0.100 cent. Steady to lower live calls on rain increased runs but may follow pork bellies.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to 1.000 cent. Bullishly construed out-of-town report but easier cash may limit gains.
